title: Effects of Leakage Flows from Secondary Flow Passages on the Flow and Efficiency of a High-Pressure Turbine
journal: The KSFM Journal of Fluid Machinery
transcription: 25 printed rows manually transcribed and checked against the page image. Four decimal places retained. No unpublished data or PDF redistributed.
input_units: x_i = (m_i/m_i0 - 1)/0.5, so -1/0/+1 mean 50/100/150 percent of each flow's own design value

target_units.delta_eta_pp: percentage points, relative to the paper's no-leakage reference; larger/less negative is better
target_units.delta_torque_nm: N m, one rotor blade, relative to the paper's no-leakage reference

limitations: Exact design mass flows unavailable here
No independent off-design, gas, grid, or phase labels
Coded-variable sensitivity is not sensitivity per kg/s
